title: About Adichunchanagiri University
content: Adichunchanagiri University (ACU) is a higher education university located at B.G. Nagara, Karnataka. The university describes itself as a NAAC A+ accredited university committed to education, research and service. The university offers programs in areas including medicine, engineering, pharmacy, nursing, allied health sciences, natural sciences, humanities and social sciences.

title: ACU Location
content: Adichunchanagiri University is located at B.G. Nagara in Mandya District, Karnataka, along NH-75.

title: ACU Faculties
content: Adichunchanagiri University has faculties covering Engineering and Technology, Medical and Allied Health Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Natural Sciences, Humanities and Social Sciences, and other academic areas. The official ACU website currently describes the university as having 8 faculties.

title: ACU Academic Programs
content: ACU offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programs. Examples include MBBS, BE engineering programs, B.Pharm, B.Sc Nursing, allied health programs, B.Com, BCA, BBA, B.Ed, MBA, M.Tech, M.Sc, MD/MS and Ph.D programs. The exact programs and availability should be checked against the official ACU program directory.

title: Faculty of Engineering and Technology
content: Engineering programs at ACU include BE programs such as Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Information Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. Postgraduate programs include M.Tech specializations, and MBA is also listed under the engineering faculty page.

title: Nursing Programs
content: ACU offers B.Sc Nursing programs through its nursing institutions. Postgraduate M.Sc Nursing specializations and Ph.D in Nursing are also listed on the official program directory.

title: ACU Admissions
content: ACU admissions include undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programs. Eligibility requirements vary by program. Some programs require entrance examinations such as NEET, state entrance examinations or an ACU entrance examination. Candidates should check the official eligibility and admissions information for the specific program they are interested in.

title: General Admission Eligibility
content: For general undergraduate admission, candidates normally need to have passed 12th standard or an equivalent qualification. Specific marks, subjects, entrance examinations and other requirements depend on the individual program and category.

title: ACU Hostel Facilities
content: ACU provides separate hostel facilities for boys and girls. The official hostel information describes furnished rooms, Wi-Fi, drinking water, housekeeping, laundry services, reading rooms and warden support. The girls' hostel information includes attached bathrooms, solar-heated hot water, CCTV monitoring and female warden supervision. Hostel facilities also include security, power backup and access to medical services.

title: ACU Academic Facilities
content: ACU's academic facilities include campus-wide Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, digital administrative services, CCTV surveillance, ERP-linked academic and examination management, a centralized analog and digital library, research laboratories, analytical laboratories and startup incubation facilities.

title: ACU Campus Facilities
content: The ACU campus provides facilities including academic buildings, a centralized library, smart classrooms, research laboratories, hostels, cafeteria and dining facilities, security, ATM facilities, an essential store, campus-wide Wi-Fi and other student support facilities.

title: ACU Fee Structure
content: ACU publishes program-specific fee information. Fees vary according to the college, program and level of study. Hostel charges are separate from tuition fees and may vary according to room type and sharing basis. Students should check the official fee structure for the current academic year before making admission decisions.

title: ACU Placements
content: ACU states that its faculties have dedicated Training and Placement Cells that support students through campus drives, industry workshops, resume development and mock interviews. Placement information varies by faculty and program, so students should check the official placement information for their specific course.

title: International Admissions
content: ACU welcomes international and SAARC students and provides support such as admission assistance, visa support, FRRO registration support and hostel accommodation. International applicants should use the official ACU international admissions information for current requirements.

title: Integrated Teacher Education Programme
content: ACU offers Integrated Teacher Education Programme pathways including B.A. B.Ed., B.Sc. B.Ed. and B.Com. B.Ed. The official ITEP page states that the programs are four-year integrated programs and admission is conducted through the National Common Entrance Test (NCET) administered by NTA.

title: BGS Institute of Technology - Engineering Programs
content: BGS Institute of Technology offers undergraduate BE programs in Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Information Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Robotics and AI. Postgraduate M.Tech programs include VLSI and Embedded Systems, Computer Science and Engineering, Structural Engineering, Infrastructure Management and Engineering, and Nano Technology. The institute also offers Master of Business Administration and doctoral programs in Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication, Civil Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering.

title: Faculty of Medical and Allied Health Sciences
content: The Faculty of Medical and Allied Health Sciences includes programs such as MBBS, B.MLS Medical Laboratory Science, B.MRIT Medical Radiology and Imaging Technology, B.DTT Dialysis Therapy Technology, B.Optom Optometry, B.AOTT Anaesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology, B.Sc Cardiac Care Technology, B.Sc Clinical Psychology, B.EMT Emergency Medical Technologist, and B.PT Bachelor of Physiotherapy. Postgraduate medical programs include MD specializations and MS specializations.

title: ACU MD Programs
content: The official ACU program directory lists MD programs in Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, Pathology, Microbiology, Pharmacology, Forensic Medicine, Community Medicine, General Medicine, Paediatrics, Dermatology, Psychiatry, Radio-Diagnosis, Anaesthesiology, and Respiratory Medicine.

title: ACU MS Programs
content: The official ACU program directory lists MS programs in General Surgery, Obstetrics and Gynaecology, ENT, Ophthalmology, and Orthopaedics.

title: Faculty of Pharmacy Programs
content: The Faculty of Pharmacy includes Sri Adichunchanagiri College of Pharmacy and BGS VIPS. Programs listed by ACU include D.Pharm, Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm), B.Pharm Lateral Entry, Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D), M.Pharm Pharmaceutical Chemistry, M.Pharm Pharmacy Practice, M.Pharm Pharmaceutics, M.Pharm Pharmaceutical Analysis, M.Pharm Pharmacology, M.Pharm Regulatory Affairs, M.Pharm Pharmacognosy, and Ph.D. in Pharmacy specialized subjects.

title: Adichunchanagiri School of Natural Sciences
content: Adichunchanagiri School of Natural Sciences offers B.Sc programs in PCM (Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics), Computer Science, and MBBt (Microbiology, Biochemistry and Biotechnology). M.Sc programs include Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Microbiology, Physics, and Computer Science. Doctoral programs listed include Ph.D. in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Microbiology, Physics, Mathematics, and Computer Science.

title: Faculty of Nursing Programs
content: The Faculty of Nursing includes Adichunchanagiri College of Nursing, BGS Institute of Nursing Sciences, and BGS Vignatam Institute of Nursing Sciences. The undergraduate program listed is B.Sc Nursing. M.Sc Nursing specializations listed include Child Paediatric Nursing, Community Health Nursing, Mental Psychiatric Nursing, Medical-Surgical Nursing, and Obstetrics and Gynaecological Nursing. ACU also lists a Ph.D. in Nursing.

title: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
content: The Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences includes BGS First Grade College, BGS College of Education, and BGS ITEP. BGS First Grade College offers B.Com, BCA, and BBA. BGS College of Education offers B.Ed. The Integrated Teacher Education Programme includes B.A. plus B.Ed., B.Com. plus B.Ed., and B.Sc. plus B.Ed.

title: ACU Colleges and Institutions
content: The official ACU program directory currently states that Adichunchanagiri University has 14 colleges. Institutions shown in the program directory include BGS Institute of Technology, BGS AIMS, BGS Medical College and Hospital, ASAHS, BGS VIAHS, BGS VIPT, Sri Adichunchanagiri College of Pharmacy, BGS VIPS, Adichunchanagiri School of Natural Sciences, Adichunchanagiri College of Nursing, BGS Institute of Nursing Sciences, BGS Vignatam Institute of Nursing Sciences, BGS First Grade College, and BGS College of Education. BGS ITEP is also listed under the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences.

title: ACU Program Levels
content: Adichunchanagiri University offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs. The official program directory currently states that ACU has 75+ programs across 8 faculties and 14 colleges.

title: BGS Institute of Technology
content: BGS Institute of Technology is the engineering institution shown under ACU's Faculty of Engineering and Technology. Its listed programs include BE, M.Tech, MBA and Ph.D. programs.

title: Medical and Allied Institutions
content: The medical and allied health section of the ACU program directory references BGS AIMS, BGS Medical College and Hospital, ASAHS, BGS VIAHS and BGS VIPT in connection with the listed medical, allied health and physiotherapy programs.

title: ACU Admission Process
content: Adichunchanagiri University admissions vary according to the program. Applicants should first check the eligibility requirements for their selected course, complete the application process, submit the required documents, and complete document verification and admission formalities. Some programs require qualifying entrance examinations such as NEET, state entrance examinations, ACU entrance tests, or other examinations specified for the program. Students should verify the current admission notification for the specific academic year.

title: MBBS Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For MBBS admission, candidates must have passed 2nd PUC or 12th with English, Physics, Chemistry and Biology. General Merit candidates require a minimum of 50% aggregate in PCB, while SC/ST/Category I candidates require a minimum of 45% aggregate in PCB. Qualification in the NEET entrance examination is mandatory.

title: B.E. Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For B.E. admission, candidates must have passed 2nd PUC or 12th with English, Physics and Mathematics together with Chemistry, Biotechnology, Biology, Electronics or Computer Science as specified. General Merit candidates require a minimum of 45% aggregate, while SC/ST/Category I candidates require a minimum of 40% aggregate. A state entrance examination or ACU entrance test is required according to the official eligibility criteria.

title: B.Pharm Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For B.Pharm admission, candidates must have passed 2nd PUC or 12th with English, Physics and Chemistry together with Biology or Mathematics. A state entrance examination or ACU entrance test is required according to the official ACU eligibility criteria.

title: Pharm.D Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For Pharm.D admission, candidates must have passed 2nd PUC or 12th with Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Mathematics, or have passed D.Pharm from a PCI-approved institution. A state entrance examination or ACU entrance test is required according to the official ACU eligibility criteria.

title: B.Sc Nursing Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For B.Sc Nursing admission, candidates must have passed 2nd PUC or 12th with English, Physics, Chemistry and Biology. General Merit candidates require a minimum of 45% aggregate in PCB and English, while SC/ST/Category I candidates require a minimum of 40% aggregate in PCB and English.

title: Post Basic B.Sc Nursing Admission
content: For Post Basic B.Sc Nursing admission, candidates must have passed a Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM), have working knowledge of English, and have a minimum of two years of working experience.

title: B.Com Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For B.Com admission, candidates must have passed PUC, 10+2 or an equivalent examination conducted by a State or Central Government authority.

title: B.Ed Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For B.Ed admission, eligibility depends on the previous qualification and category. Candidates may qualify with a recognised degree or with a Master's degree, B.E. or B.Tech with Science and Mathematics as specified by ACU. Minimum marks differ between General Merit and SC/ST/Category I candidates. A state entrance examination or ACU entrance test is required according to the official criteria.

title: Allied Health Sciences Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For Allied Health Sciences programs including B.MLS, B.MRIT, B.Optom., B.DTT, B.AOTT and B.EMT, candidates must have passed 2nd PUC or 12th or an equivalent examination with English and Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Mathematics as principal subjects. Candidates who completed diploma or vocational courses through correspondence are not eligible for these programs according to the official eligibility criteria.

title: MD and MS Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For MD and MS admission, candidates must have passed MBBS from an MCI-recognised medical college and must be declared qualified in NEET-PG.

title: M.Tech Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For M.Tech admission, candidates must have completed B.E. or B.Tech from an AICTE-recognised institute. The minimum aggregate is 50% for General Merit and 45% for SC/ST/Category I candidates. A state entrance examination is required according to the official eligibility criteria.

title: MBA Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For MBA admission, candidates require a bachelor's degree. General Merit candidates require 50% aggregate, while SC/ST/Category I candidates require 45% aggregate. Accepted entrance examinations listed by ACU include K-MAT, PGCET and CAT.

title: M.Pharm Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For M.Pharm admission, candidates must have a B.Pharm qualification from a PCI-recognised institute. The minimum aggregate is 55% for General Merit and 50% for SC/ST/Category I candidates.

title: M.Sc Nursing Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For M.Sc Nursing admission, candidates must have B.Sc Nursing, B.Sc Honours Nursing or Post Basic B.Sc Nursing from an INC-recognised institute and at least one year of work experience. General Merit candidates require 55% aggregate, while SC/ST/Category I candidates require 50% aggregate.

title: Ph.D Admission Eligibility at ACU
content: For Ph.D admission, candidates generally require a postgraduate degree in the relevant subject from a recognised university. The official eligibility criteria specify minimum marks that vary by category and qualification. The ACU Ph.D Entrance Test is required unless an applicable exemption such as GATE, UGC-NET, GPAT or M.Phil applies. Exempt candidates must still appear for the interview.

title: ACU Admissions Contact
content: For UG, PG and Ph.D applications, eligibility guidance, fee structure, entrance test coordination and counselling, students can contact the ACU Admissions Cell. The official contact page lists admissions@acu.edu.in and phone number 08234 287271.

title: International and SAARC Admissions at ACU
content: International applicants may need academic mark sheets, degree certificates for postgraduate applicants, an AIU equivalence certificate for foreign qualifications, transfer and conduct certificates, a migration certificate, passport copies, photographs, a student visa and relevant entrance examination scores. ACU provides admission and visa-support assistance for international students.

title: ACU Admission Fee Information
content: Admission and tuition fees vary by program. ACU states that detailed fee breakdowns are provided in the official notification for each program. Students should contact the Admissions Cell for the current fee structure rather than relying on a general fee amount.

title: ACU Hostel Facilities
content: Adichunchanagiri University provides separate hostel facilities for boys and girls. The official ACU hostel page currently describes more than 10 hostel blocks, more than 2000 bed capacity, 24/7 warden support and campus-wide Wi-Fi coverage.

title: ACU Boys Hostel
content: The ACU boys hostel provides furnished rooms on a sharing basis with cots, study tables and chairs. Facilities include high-speed Wi-Fi, filtered drinking water, regular housekeeping, laundry services, reading rooms, tutorial rooms and 24/7 warden support.

title: ACU Girls Hostel
content: The ACU girls hostel provides separate secured residential blocks with attached bathrooms, solar-heated hot water, dedicated reading rooms and 24/7 female warden supervision. The official page also describes CCTV monitoring, indoor recreation facilities, generator backup and guest-house facilities for visiting parents.

title: ACU Hostel Security
content: ACU hostel facilities include CCTV surveillance, access control, round-the-clock security personnel, on-site wardens and emergency response arrangements. The hostel page also describes medical access through the on-campus hospital.

title: ACU Hostel Amenities
content: ACU hostel amenities include campus-wide Wi-Fi, RO purified drinking water, housekeeping, laundry services, 24/7 security, medical access, power backup and solar-heated hot water. Reading rooms and indoor recreation facilities are also available.

title: ACU Hostel Dining
content: ACU hostel mess facilities provide daily meals. The official hostel page describes a menu including South Indian and North Indian food. Listed meal timings include breakfast from 7:30 AM to 8:30 AM, lunch from 12:30 PM to 2:00 PM, tea or coffee from 4:30 PM to 5:30 PM, and dinner from 7:30 PM to 8:30 PM.

title: ACU Hostel Rules
content: ACU hostel residents are expected to follow hostel discipline and safety rules. The official hostel page states that ragging, harassment, smoking, alcohol and intoxicating substances are prohibited. Entry and exit records are maintained, unauthorized visitors are restricted, and students are responsible for hostel property.

title: ACU Campus Transport
content: Adichunchanagiri University provides regular campus bus services connecting the B.G. Nagara campus with Bengaluru, Mandya and Mysuru. The university also provides shuttle coordination for inter-campus transportation and parking facilities.

title: ACU Bus Routes
content: The main ACU campus transport information identifies Bengaluru, Mandya and Mysuru routes. Individual constituent institutions may have additional routes or schedules. Students should verify current route timings and availability with the relevant institution or transport coordinator.

title: BGSIT Transport Facilities
content: BGS Institute of Technology operates institutional bus services on routes including Bengaluru, Mandya and Mysuru. Its official transport information also describes routes connecting Hassan and Tumkur through the NH-75 corridor. Transport schedules and availability should be confirmed with BGSIT.

title: ACU Road Connectivity
content: The ACU main campus is located at B.G. Nagara on National Highway 75, about 1 km west of Bellur Cross. The official ACU contact page describes road connectivity from Bengaluru, Mysuru, Mandya and Hassan. Direct KSRTC and private bus services operate on NH-75 and buses stop at BG Nagara or Bellur Cross.

title: ACU Rail Connectivity
content: The ACU contact page lists Nagamangala, Mandya and Bengaluru City among the nearby railway connections. Nagamangala is approximately 10 km from the campus, while Mandya is approximately 65 km away.

title: ACU Air Connectivity
content: Kempegowda International Airport in Bengaluru is the nearest major airport listed by ACU. The official ACU contact page gives an approximate distance of 140 km via NH-75 and notes that taxis can be used to reach the campus.

title: BGS Institute of Technology - Complete Overview
content: BGS Institute of Technology (BGSIT) is a constituent college of Adichunchanagiri University located at B.G. Nagara. BGSIT was established in 2001 and became a constituent college of Adichunchanagiri University in 2020. The institute is AICTE approved, NAAC A+ accredited, and has NBA-accredited programs including CSE and ECE. BGSIT offers undergraduate B.E., postgraduate M.Tech and MBA, and doctoral programs. The institute has a 21-acre campus, engineering laboratories, AICTE IDEA Lab, central library, smart classrooms, hostels, sports facilities and cafeteria.

title: BGSIT Undergraduate Engineering Programs
content: BGS Institute of Technology offers B.E. programs in Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Information Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. The B.E. programs are four-year undergraduate engineering programs.

title: BGSIT Postgraduate Programs
content: BGSIT offers postgraduate programs including M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, VLSI Design, Structural Engineering, Infrastructure Management, AI and Data Science, and Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. BGSIT also offers MBA. Program availability and admission requirements should be verified against the current official admission notification.

title: BGSIT PhD Programs
content: BGSIT offers doctoral research opportunities in engineering areas including Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Civil Engineering and Mechanical Engineering.

title: BGSIT Departments
content: The engineering departments at BGSIT include Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Information Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. BGSIT also has Basic Science and Management studies areas.

title: BGSIT Computer Science and Engineering
content: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at BGSIT was established in 2005. The department offers B.E. Computer Science and Engineering and is NBA accredited. The department focuses on software engineering, algorithms, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, cyber security, full-stack development and related computing technologies. The department has an IDEA Innovation Lab, AI and ML workstations and a Cyber Security centre. The official department page describes industry partnerships, internships and project-based learning.

title: BGSIT CSE HOD
content: The official BGSIT Computer Science and Engineering department page identifies Dr. Manu Y M as Professor and Head of the Department of Computer Science. His listed qualifications include M.Tech and Ph.D.

title: BGSIT Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
content: The BGSIT Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning department offers B.E. Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. The department focuses on deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, reinforcement learning, intelligent systems and data-driven decision making. The department uses technologies and frameworks including TensorFlow, PyTorch and Scikit-learn and has dedicated GPU-equipped AI and deep learning laboratories.

title: BGSIT AI and ML Head of Department
content: The official BGSIT Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning page identifies Dr. Siddartha B K as Associate Professor and Head of the Department of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. His listed qualifications include M.Tech and Ph.D.

title: BGSIT Electronics and Communication Engineering
content: The BGSIT Electronics and Communication Engineering department offers B.E. Electronics and Communication Engineering. The department covers AI and ML, IoT, VLSI design, embedded systems, communication technologies, signal processing and related electronics areas. It has a Centre of Excellence in Drone and IoT. BGSIT also offers M.Tech in VLSI Design and Embedded Systems and Ph.D. opportunities in Electronics and Communication.

title: BGSIT ECE HOD
content: The official BGSIT Electronics and Communication Engineering department page identifies Dr. Naveen K B as Professor and Head of the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering.

title: BGSIT Civil Engineering
content: The BGSIT Civil Engineering department offers B.E. Civil Engineering. The department provides training in structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, transportation engineering, environmental engineering and modern construction techniques. Laboratories include surveying, geotechnical engineering, structural analysis and environmental engineering facilities. Students can work with technologies and software including BIM, AutoCAD and STAAD.Pro. The department also provides consultancy in planning, structural design and material testing.

title: BGSIT Civil Engineering Head of Department
content: The official BGSIT Civil Engineering page identifies Dr. Shruthi R as Head of the Department of Civil Engineering. Her listed qualifications include M.Tech and Ph.D.

title: BGSIT Mechanical Engineering
content: BGSIT offers B.E. Mechanical Engineering. The department covers thermal engineering, machine design, manufacturing technologies and related mechanical engineering areas. The official faculty directory identifies Dr. Manjunath S H as Professor and Head of the Mechanical Engineering Department.

title: BGSIT Information Science and Engineering
content: BGSIT offers B.E. Information Science and Engineering. The program focuses on computer networks, web technologies, information security and related information technology areas, with industry internship opportunities.

title: BGSIT Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
content: BGSIT offers B.E. Robotics and Artificial Intelligence. The program focuses on autonomous systems, control engineering, kinematics, robotics and artificial intelligence technologies.

content: BGSIT has a Basic Science area covering foundational subjects including mathematics, physics, chemistry and humanities-related foundation courses. The official faculty directory identifies Dr. B K Yuvaraja as Professor and Head of the Basic Science Department and Dr. Shankara S R as Associate Professor and Head of the Physics Department.

title: Adichunchanagiri Institute of Medical Sciences
content: Adichunchanagiri Institute of Medical Sciences, or AIMS, is a constituent college of Adichunchanagiri University located at B.G. Nagara, Karnataka. The institute was established in 1986. It is recognised by the National Medical Commission and is accredited NAAC A+. AIMS is integrated with the Adichunchanagiri Hospital and Research Centre for hospital-based clinical training.

title: AIMS Programmes
content: AIMS offers MBBS at undergraduate level and MD and MS postgraduate medical programmes. The official AIMS website describes MBBS as a five and a half year programme including internship. MD and MS are three year postgraduate speciality programmes.

title: AIMS Pre and Para-Clinical Departments
content: The AIMS Pre and Para-Clinical departments listed on the official website are Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, Pathology, Microbiology, Pharmacology, Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, Community Medicine, Cardiology, and Clinical Immunology and Rheumatology.

title: AIMS Medicine and Allied Departments
content: The AIMS Medicine and Allied departments listed on the official website are General Medicine, Dermatology, Venereology and Leprosy, Pediatrics, Emergency Medicine, Pulmonary Medicine, Psychiatry, Radiology, Nephrology, and Medical Oncology.

title: AIMS Surgery and Allied Departments
content: The AIMS Surgery and Allied departments listed on the official website are General Surgery, Anaesthesiology, Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Ophthalmology, Orthopedics, ENT and Head and Neck Surgery, Urology, Surgical Oncology, Plastic Surgery, Neurosurgery, and Dentistry.

title: ASNS Departments
content: Adichunchanagiri School of Natural Sciences has seven science disciplines: Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Physics, Computer Science and Mathematics. Biochemistry covers areas such as enzyme kinetics, clinical biochemistry, metabolomics and molecular diagnostics. Biotechnology includes genetic engineering, bioinformatics, recombinant DNA technology and industrial bioprocessing. Microbiology covers medical, virology, immunology, food and environmental microbiology. Chemistry includes organic synthesis, analytical chemistry, material science and green chemistry. Physics includes condensed matter, spectroscopy, material science, computational physics and astrophysics. Computer Science includes programming, algorithms, data structures, artificial intelligence, data science and advanced software development. Mathematics includes real analysis, abstract algebra and applied mathematics.

Laboratory training includes techniques such as aseptic culture, spectrophotometry, electrophoresis, PCR and enzyme assays. Eligibility is PUC or 10+2 with a Science stream including Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Mathematics, with a minimum of 45 percent, or 40 percent for SC/ST candidates. The listed tuition fee is thirty-five thousand rupees per year and the application fee is four hundred rupees.

title: ACU Ph.D. Programme
content: Adichunchanagiri University offers Ph.D. programmes across 8 faculties and more than 40 research areas. title: ACU Ph.D. Eligibility
content: Candidates seeking admission to the ACU Ph.D. programme generally require a Master's degree or equivalent in the relevant discipline from a recognised university. The current ACU Ph.D. information specifies a minimum of 55 percent marks, with 50 percent for eligible SC/ST and other categories as per applicable UGC norms. Discipline-specific requirements may apply. Candidates must also satisfy the current ACU Ph.D. regulations and supervisor availability requirements.

title: ACU Ph.D. Entrance Test
content: The ACU Research Entrance Test, commonly called ACU-RET, is part of the Ph.D. admission process. Candidates who hold recognised qualifications such as UGC-NET, CSIR-NET, GATE, GPAT, SLET or equivalent national-level qualifications may be exempted from ACU-RET according to the applicable regulations. Exempted candidates must still participate in the required interview or viva voce process. Qualification in an entrance test does not by itself guarantee admission because admission depends on seats and supervisor availability.

title: ACU Ph.D. Admission Categories
content: The ACU Ph.D. Regulations 2025 provide seven admission categories. They are full-time candidates with national fellowships, full-time candidates with ACU scholarships, full-time self-financed candidates, full-time project fellows, full-time international candidates, joint or co-supervised international researchers, and part-time working professionals.

title: ACU Full-Time Ph.D.
content: ACU offers full-time Ph.D. study through multiple admission categories. Full-time scholars may be admitted with national fellowships, ACU scholarships, as self-financed scholars or as project fellows. Full-time Ph.D. has a minimum duration of 3 years and a maximum duration of 6 years. Mandatory coursework is completed during the initial research period.

title: ACU Part-Time Ph.D.
content: ACU provides a part-time Ph.D. pathway for eligible working professionals. Part-time Ph.D. has a minimum duration of 4 years and a maximum duration of 8 years. Working candidates must provide a No-Objection Certificate from their employer. The current regulations also require prescribed physical presence at the university and completion of mandatory coursework.

title: ACU Ph.D. Duration
content: The full-time ACU Ph.D. programme has a minimum duration of 3 years and a maximum duration of 6 years. The part-time Ph.D. programme has a minimum duration of 4 years and a maximum duration of 8 years. Mandatory coursework is completed during the initial stage of the programme.

title: ACU Ph.D. Coursework
content: Ph.D. scholars at ACU must complete mandatory coursework during the initial stage of their doctoral programme. The current regulations specify coursework within the first 6 months. Scholars must successfully complete the prescribed coursework before progressing through the research and thesis stages.

title: ACU Ph.D. Research Proposal
content: Applicants to the ACU Ph.D. programme must prepare a research proposal. The proposal should describe the proposed research area, objectives, literature survey, methodology, expected outcomes and research plan. The proposal is evaluated during the interview or viva voce process.

title: ACU Ph.D. Research Supervisors
content: ACU Ph.D. scholars conduct their research under approved research supervisors. The current ACU research information lists 125 approved Ph.D. guides across 8 faculties. Candidates must identify a recognised supervisor whose research area matches the proposed research and whose guideship is valid with ACU. Supervisor availability and approved research capacity are considered during admission.

title: ACU Ph.D. Fellowship
content: ACU provides fellowship support for eligible full-time Ph.D. scholars.
